objective: Bake Rush saves: load and save progress with DataStoreService, validate loaded data, never overwrite saved data after a failed load, and save on leave, shutdown and every 60 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Loaded data is sanitised: clamped, floored and defaulted (SaveRules unit tests)
A failed load kicks the player and never saves over existing data
Actions are ignored until the load has finished
Session lock and save count prevent a stale or second server from overwriting a record (SaveRules unit tests)
Progress survives leave and rejoin in the staging experience
verification: Lune tests for SaveRules, plus a two-session staging playtest that checks progress after rejoin
evidence: Local run on 2026-10-24: lune run tests/run 48/48 passed (BakeRules and SaveRules specs now registered in tests/run.luau); stylua --check clean; rojo build OK; validate-tasks OK; secret scan clean.
Selene not run locally (roblox std needs network); relies on CI.
The DataStore code has not run in Studio yet.
notes: High risk because it touches player data. Schema v2 adds saveCount and lock.
